blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: General multi-object tracking (GMOT) tracks all instances of a user-specified category from a single first-frame exemplar. Prior work relies on bounding boxes and surrogate training, and struggles with non-rigid objects, crowded scenes, and distractors. We introduce UGO, a unified GMOT tracker that pairs a pretrained exemplar-conditioned detection head with an instance-propagation head in a common architecture. A novel training-free, energy-minimization consolidation method converts overlapping proposals into exclusive pixel-wise masks and detections, resolving over-segmentation, duplicates, and conflicts. A hierarchical memory spanning global and instance levels improves recall and per-instance segmentation accuracy using a new memory management protocol. UGO sets a new state-of-the-art on GMOT benchmarks and video object counting, and is competitive with specialist MOT methods, establishing a strong paradigm for unified, open-category multi-object tracking. The code will be available here .
blocks.zh: 普通多对象跟踪(GMOT)从单个一帧实例中跟踪用户指定类别的所有实例. 之前的工作依赖于边框和代孕训练,与非刚性物体,拥挤的场景和分心者相搏. 我们引入了UGO,一个统一的GMOT跟踪器,它将一个预先训练的模具条件检测头与一个实例传播头在共同的架构中相配. 一种新的无能、能最小化的整合方法,将重叠的提案转换成独有的像素般的口罩和检测,解决过分分化、重复和冲突。 跨越全球和实例层次的分级内存利用新的内存管理协议,提高了召回和分级的准确性。 UGO为GMOT基准和视频对象计数设定了新的最先进的技术,并且与专业的MOT方法具有竞争力,为统一,开放的多对象跟踪建立了强大的范式. 代码将在这里提供。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Given a single instance exemplar, e.g., specified by a bounding box in the first frame, the task of general multi-object tracking (GMOT) is to track all instances of the same category throughout the video.
This extends two classical problems: single-object tracking (SOT) [ 16 ] , which extracts a trajectory of a single selected instance of an arbitrary category, and multi-object tracking (MOT) [ 13 ] , which detects and associates multiple instances of a predefined class using a category-specific detector.
GMOT thus unifies the generalization requirement of SOT with the coverage of MOT, while operating without category-specific training data, making it a fundamentally challenging problem.
blocks.zh:
鉴于一个单一实例,例如由第一帧中的边框所指定,一般多对象跟踪(GMOT)的任务是在整个视频中跟踪同一类别的所有实例.
这扩展了两个古典问题:单对象跟踪(SOT) [16],它提取一个任意类的单个所选实例的轨迹;多对象跟踪(MOT) [13],它使用一个类别特定探测器来探测并关联一个预定义类的多个实例.
因此,GMOT统一了涵盖MOT的SOT的通缩要求,同时在没有特定类别培训数据的情况下运作,使其成为一个根本有挑战性的问题。

blocks.en:
Most GMOT methods [ 15 ; 38 ; 41 ; 12 ] are direct adaptations of the classical online MOT paradigm, combining a detector, Kalman-based instance propagation, and Hungarian matching to associate detections with instance predictions. Alternatively, tracking and detection association is posed as an end-to-end trainable detection problem [ 23 ] in the context of query-based detectors [ 10 ] .
Since sufficiently diverse GMOT training data is unavailable, these methods rely on surrogate training on detection datasets, which cannot capture the complex dynamics of instance interactions. Moreover, all current methods localize targets as bounding boxes, which may be adequate for approximating pedestrians, but poorly approximate general non-compact and deformable objects, making the association unreliable, particularly in crowded scenes with overlapping instances.
blocks.zh:
多数GMOT方法[15;38;41;12]是古典在线MOT范式的直接改编,结合了一种探测器,以Kalman为基础的实例传播,以及匈牙利语将检测与实例预测联系起来。 或者,在基于查询的探测器[10]中,跟踪和检测关联被视为一个端到端的可训练检测问题。
由于缺乏足够多样的GMOT培训数据,这些方法依赖于检测数据集的代培训,无法捕捉实例相互作用的复杂动态. 此外,所有现行方法都将目标定位为捆绑箱,这可能适合近似行人,但不太接近一般的不相容和可变形的物体,使得协会不可靠,特别是在有重叠事件的拥挤场景中.

blocks.en:
In general, all instances are better represented by segmentation masks, which enable pixel-level instance separation.
This is explored in video object segmentation [ 42 ] , where masks of all tracked instances are jointly inferred.
However, architectures for joint instance prediction do not scale to a large number of objects and require dedicated training sets.
Alternatively, recent video foundation models [ 33 ] hold the potential to independently track all instances, but these become unreliable under strong instance interactions and require external initialization at each new instance.
blocks.zh:
一般情况下,所有实例都由分解口罩来更好地代表,这些口罩可以使像素级实例分离.
在视频物体分解[42]中对此进行了探讨,其中共同推断出所有被跟踪事件的口罩.
然而,联合实例预测的架构并不包括大量对象,需要专门的培训。
或者,最近的视频基础模型[33]有可能独立跟踪所有实例,但在强实例互动下这些实例变得不可靠,需要在每个新实例中进行外部初始化。

blocks.en:
We address the aforementioned issues, by proposing UGO, a Unified General multiple Object tracker, that unifies recent advances in general object detection and the expressiveness of the video segmentation foundation models within a single architecture.
UGO applies a video foundation backbone [ 33 ] with two lightweight heads, one for detecting instances corresponding to the user-provided exemplar, and another for frame-to-frame identity propagation.
Both use the same segmentation module to predict calibrated per-pixel object presence beliefs, which may contain oversegmentation, double detections, and duplicated tracks (Figure 1 ).
These are resolved into unique, pixel-wise exclusive tracked instance segmentations and detections of new instances by a novel training-free consolidation module, formulated as an energy-minimization problem with a global exclusivity objective.
The novel design avoids the need for extensive, diverse GMOT-specific training datasets to solve complex combinatorial optimization problems efficiently.
To ensure robustness to distractors and to align the detector with within-category instance appearance variation, we propose a hierarchical adaptive memory (HAM) composed of a detector category-level memory and individual per-instance memories.
The memories are updated by jointly considering the tracks of all instances. UGO shows insensitivity to the hyperparameters commonly applied in MOT/GMOT settings, confirming its robust design.
blocks.zh:
我们通过提出UGO这一统一通用多对象跟踪器来解决上述问题,该跟踪器统一了一般物体探测方面的最新进展以及视频分块基础模型在单一架构内的表现。
UGO采用了一个视频地基主干线[33],有两个轻量级头,一个用于检测与用户提供的示例相对应的事件,另一个用于帧到帧的身份传播.
两者都使用相同的分块模块来预测被校正的每像素对象存在信仰,这些信仰可能包含过分分,双检测和重复的轨道(图1).
通过一个新的无培训整合模块,这些模块被解决为独特的、像素型的独家跟踪实例分解和发现新的实例,该模块是作为一个具有全球专属目标的能最小化问题而拟定的。
小说设计避免了需要广泛,多样的GMOT特定培训数据集来高效地解决复杂的组合优化问题.
为确保能对分心者进行强健,并使探测器与类内实例外观变异相配合,我们提议建立一个由探测器类级内存和个人每层内存组成的分级适应内存.
通过共同考虑所有实例的轨迹来更新记忆。 UGO显示出对MOT/GMOT设置中常用的超参数表的不灵敏度,证实了其稳健的设计.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are: (i) a new general multi-object tracking paradigm with independently applied single-object trackers and detectors, coupled through mask consolidation and memory feedback to achieve a global coordination; (ii) a novel training-free energy-based consolidation module that delivers per-pixel exclusive segmentation masks from per-instance tracks and detections; (iii) a hierarchical adaptive memory (HAM) with a management protocol based on explicit failure detection, ensuring robust instance detection and identity propagation in the presence of distractors.
UGO unifies SOT, MOT, and GMOT in a single framework, achieving state-of-the-art performance and defining a new paradigm in category-agnostic multi-object tracking.
blocks.zh:
我们的贡献是:(一) 新的通用多物体跟踪模式,采用独立应用的单物体跟踪仪和探测器,同时通过面具整合和内存反馈实现全球协调;(二) 新的无能培训整合模块,从每段轨道和探测器中提供每个像素专用分解口罩;(三) 分级适应存储器(HAM),其管理协议基于明确的故障检测,确保强力实例检测和在分心器面前传播身份。
UGO将SOT,MOT,和GMOT统一在一个框架内,实现最先进的性能,并定义了类别不可知多对象跟踪中的新范式.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Multi-Object Tracking (MOT). In classical MOT pipelines such as SORT [ 5 ] , DeepSORT [ 38 ] , Tracktor [ 4 ] , and ByteTrack [ 44 ] , detectors produce per-frame boxes or masks, which are then associated by motion or appearance cues.
Mask-level variants [ 37 ] (MOTS) extend this pipeline to segmentation.
The methods excel in closed-world setups with strong class-specific detectors available, while their stability hinges on detector recall – missed detections lead to trajectory fragmentation – thus they underperform on long-tail categories. Recent works such as TrackFormer [ 27 ] and TransTrack [ 35 ] use DETR-like queries for joint detection and identity propagation. However, as noted in [ 14 ] , this creates a conflict between category semantics (detection) and instance specificity (association). In addition, most methods require per-category training and lack pixel-level exclusivity across similar instances, causing overlaps and ID switches in crowded scenes.
blocks.zh:
多目标跟踪(MOT). 在SORT [5],DeepSORT [38], tracktor [4],和 ByteTrack [44]等古典MOT管道中,探测器产生出每帧箱或口罩,然后通过运动或外观提示相接.
遮罩级变体 [37] (MOTS)将这一管线延伸至分块.
这种方法在闭合世界的布局中非常出色,拥有强大的分类探测器,而其稳定性则取决于探测器的召回 — — 缺失的探测导致轨迹分解 — — 因此在长尾分类上表现不佳。 近期的作品有TrackFormer [27]和Track [35] 使用类似DETR的查询进行联合检测和身份传播. 然而,正如[14]所指出,这在语义(检测)和特异性(关联)之间造成了冲突。 此外,大多数方法都需要每类培训,在类似情况下缺乏像素级别的专属性,在拥挤的场景中造成重叠和ID开关.

blocks.en:
General single object trackers (SOT). Modern SOT enable tracking of any instance and are highly robust to appearance changes and occlusion [ 33 ; 36 ; 11 ] , while recent memory mechanisms improve reliability under distractors [ 36 ; 17 ] .
However, SOT lacks scene-level competition and cannot ensure mutual exclusivity among many look-alikes; naively running multiple SOT instances on MOT datasets is prone to identity swaps.
But SOT methods cannot discover new instances appearing in the video, and optimize per-target propagation rather than frame-level joint reasoning over all instances.
blocks.zh:
普通单天体跟踪仪(SOT). 现代SOT能够跟踪任何实例,并且对外观变化和隐蔽性[33;36;11]非常有力;而最近的内存机制在分光器下提高了可靠性[36;17].
然而,SOT缺乏场景级的竞争,无法确保许多外观相似者之间的相互专属性;在MOT数据集上天真地运行多起SOT事件,容易发生身份交换.
但SOT方法无法发现视频中出现的新事件,并优化每个目标的传播,而不是所有情况下的帧级联合推理.

blocks.en:
General & open-category tracking. General multi-object tracking (GMOT) extends MOT to tracking any instance of an unseen category, specified by a single instance exemplar.
The GMOT-40 benchmark [ 3 ] established a standardized evaluation setting, demonstrating that a straightforward combination of a one-shot detector [ 15 ] and a target association module [ 32 ; 41 ; 6 ] provides a simple, yet limited baseline.
Subsequent methods, including PLGMOT [ 25 ] and S-DETR [ 23 ] , introduce exemplar-conditioned detection and transformer-based association. While PLGMOT enables instance discovery, its tracking-by-detection design limits recall. S-DETR improves this via exemplar-conditioned queries and dynamic track reuse. However, both remain restricted to box-level reasoning and NMS-based conflict resolution, causing identity switches in crowded scenes. Recently, SAM3 [ 9 ] extended single-object tracking toward open-vocabulary tracking, integrating detection capabilities, but it still lacks explicit pixel-level interaction reasoning among tracked instances.
blocks.zh:
常规并开放分类跟踪. 一般多对象跟踪(GMOT)将 MOT 扩展为跟踪单个实例所指定的任何未见类别实例.
GMOT-40基准[3]确立了一个标准化的评价设置,表明一发式探测器[15]和目标关联模块[32;41;6]的直截了当的组合提供了简单而有限的基线.
随后的方法,包括PLGMOT [25]和S-DETR [23],引入了以实例为条件的检测和变压器相接. 虽然PLGMOT使实例发现成为可能,但其逐一追踪和检测设计限制却回想起了这一点。 S-DETR通过附加条件的查询和动态轨道再用来改进这一点. 然而,两者仍然限于箱级推理和基于核磁共振的解决冲突,在拥挤的场景中造成身份开关。 最近,SAM3 [9]扩展了单对象跟踪,向开放-vocabulary跟踪,整合了检测能力,但它在被跟踪的案例中仍然缺乏明确的像素级交互推理.

blocks.en: 3 A Unified General Multiple Object Tracker
blocks.zh: 3 统一通用多对象跟踪器

blocks.en:
Given a sequence of N N video frames { 𝐈 t } t = 1 : N \{\mathbf{I}_{t}\}_{t=1:N} and an instance category exemplar bounding box 𝐛 1 E \mathbf{b}^{E}_{1} provided in the first frame, the task is to track all instances of the same category in the video. We propose a unified general multiple object tracker (UGO) (Figure 2 ).
At time-step t t , UGO already tracks some of the instances from the previous frame and proceeds in the current frame as follows. The input image 𝐈 t ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 \mathbf{I}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3} is encoded by the Hiera [ 34 ] backbone into 𝐅 t ∈ ℝ h × w × c \mathbf{F}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{h\times w\times c} , with spatial resolution h × w h\times w and c c feature channels. The features are passed to two light-weight heads. The first is the SAM2 [ 33 ] video segmentation head that propagates tracked instances from the previous time-step (Section 3.1 ).
The second head is based on GECO2 [ 30 ] and detects all new instances and potentially also those already tracked, matching the exemplar category (Section 3.2 ).
Both heads apply a pretrained SAM2 mask decoder, delivering compatible per-pixel logits, which enables consolidation of detector and tracker outputs into mutually exclusive masks (Section 3.3 ).
The consolidation influences memory updating: the resolved conflicts trigger the affected tracker memory updates. The individual trackers are thus implicitly coupled through shared pixel-level decisions, forming a feedback loop that reduces future overlaps and stabilizes identity tracking (Section 3.5 ).
This substantially simplifies trajectory management (Section 3.4 ).

blocks.en: 3.3 Detector and tracker output consolidation
blocks.zh: 3.3 探测器和跟踪器产出合并

blocks.en:
The use of the same pre-trained SAM2 segmentation head by the detector and tracker ensures calibrated and compatible logits in 𝒯 t \mathcal{T}_{t} and 𝒟 t \mathcal{D}_{t} , which could be naïvely converted to masks by thresholding at zero.
However, these masks indicate all pixels that may belong to the detector/tracker instance, not accounting for other instances. Thus, the masks will not be mutually exclusive, with some objects covered by both detectors and trackers, multiple trackers including distractor objects, and masks of different objects potentially overlapping due to over-segmentation (Figure 3 ).
Because of these nontrivial interactions, the classical MOT bipartite [ 18 ; 7 ] or quadratic [ 39 ] optimization, even if redesigned to operate at the per-mask level, and disregarding the significant compute complexity, cannot be applied for conflict resolving.
blocks.zh:
探测器和跟踪器使用相同的预训SAM2分片头,可保证在 T\mathcal{T}_{t}和 D t\mathcal{D}_{t}中校正并相容的对数,通过0分的阈值可以天真地转换为口罩.
然而,这些口罩表示所有可能属于探测器/跟踪器实例的像素,而不计入其他实例. 因此,口罩不会相互排斥,有些物体被探测器和追踪器所覆盖,多个追踪器包括分心器物体,以及不同物体的口罩由于过分分隔而可能重叠(图3)。
由于这些非三相相互作用,古典的MOT双相 [18; 7] 或四相 [39] 优化,即使重新设计后在每任务一级运行,而忽略了重大的计算复杂性,也不能用于解决冲突.

blocks.en: 3.4 Instance track lifecycle management
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 实例跟踪生命周期管理

blocks.en:
After consolidation, only two types of mutually-exclusive masks remain: (i) masks corresponding to instance trackers and (ii) masks corresponding to newly detected instances.
Standard MOT rules are applied next for trajectory management. Initialization & Update. New single-target trackers are initialized on detection masks, while the instance trackers are updated with their consolidated masks. Termination. A tracker is flagged for termination when its mask collapses due to drift, or when the object leaves the field of view. In practice, the flag is raised when consolidation returns an empty mask.
If the condition is met for ten consecutive frames, the tracker is terminated. Initialized track validation. To remove tracks initialized on a false positive detection, they are classified as valid only after frequently confirmed by the detector.
As a standard rule, tracks with 30 % \% of their masks confirmed are declared valid, where a tracker mask M t , k M_{t,k} is considered confirmed if its IoU with any of the detectors is greater than the moderate τ md \tau_{\text{md}} , i.e., max d ∈ 𝒟 t ⁡ IoU ⁡ ( M t , k , d > 0 ) ≥ τ md . \max_{d\in\mathcal{D}_{t}}\operatorname{IoU}(M_{t,k},d>0)\geq\tau_{\text{md}}. UGO employs a hierarchical adaptive memory (HAM) to represent the targets at two levels of detail.

blocks.en:
Instance-level memory ℳ t , k T \mathcal{M}_{t,k}^{T} stores segmented examples of k k -th instance and is used for its localization by the tracker. As in [ 36 ] , the memory is split into distractor-resolving memory (DRM), responsible for discriminating between the target and visually-similar objects, and recent appearance memory (RAM), responsible for frame-to-frame segmentation accuracy – each a FIFO buffer with three DRM and four RAM slots.
Both are updated from non-empty tracker outputs, with RAM updated as in [ 36 ] , while we introduce a new DRM update protocol.
The standard assumption [ 36 ] that the initialization frame provides an iconic target with ground-truth segmentation does not hold in GMOT, where trackers are initialized from potentially inaccurate detections. Therefore, the initialization frame should not be retained in DRM indefinitely [ 33 ; 36 ] .
We instead leverage detector–tracker consolidation to identify frames with distractors. DRM is updated when the tracker mask before and after consolidation no longer reflect a high agreement (IoU < τ hi <\tau_{\text{hi}} ), while the consolidated mask is detector-confirmed (Eq. 7 ), indicating correction of distractor over-segmentation. Figure 3 visualizes the benefits of using the proposed DRM updating scheme.

blocks.en:
We follow the standard GMOT evaluation protocol [ 3 ] , where a single target exemplar is provided in the first frame.
Performance is evaluated by MOT measures, with the primary being MOTA, which integrates false positives, false negatives, and identity switches.
Where possible, we also report HOTA [ 26 ] , which jointly measures detection (DetA) and association (AssA) accuracy and provides a more reliable overall assessment than MOTA [ 26 ] .
Several auxiliary measures are used. Identity preservation is measured by IDP, IDR, and their harmonic mean IDF1. Trajectory quality is quantified by MT, PT, and ML, denoting the number of mostly tracked ( > 80 % >80\% ), partially tracked ( 20 ​ - ​ 80 % 20\text{-}80\% ), or mostly lost ( < 20 % <20\% ) identities, respectively. We also report false positives (FP), false negatives (FN), F1 score, identity switches (IDSw), and fragmentations (FM).

blocks.en:
UGO is compared on GMOT-40 [ 3 ] benchmark with GMOT trackers, including the five versions of the current best state-of-the-art S-DETR [ 23 ] (Table 1 ).
UGO consistently outperforms all competitors.
It outperforms S-DETR [ 23 ] by 23 % 23\% MOTA, reflecting joint improvements in detection quality, association accuracy, and long-term trajectory consistency.
It also outperforms S-DETR [ 23 ] by 52% IDF1, indicating a substantially better instance identity preservation.
We also evaluate SAM3 [ 9 ] with default parameters (see supplementary), which only supports prompt-based tracking – we thus initialize it with the category names of target objects.
Despite this semantic advantage, UGO surpasses SAM3 by 6% in HOTA and 22% in MOTA, demonstrating markedly stronger instance coverage and overall tracking robustness.
blocks.zh:
UGO在GMOT-40[3]基准上被与GMOT跟踪器比较,包括目前最先进的S-DETR[23]的五个版本(表1).
UGO一贯超越所有竞争对手。
它的性能比S-DETR [23] 高23% 23% MOTA,反映了检测质量,关联精度,以及长期轨迹一致性等共同改进.
它还比S-DETR[23] 高出52%的以色列国防军1,表明保存身份的情况要好得多。
我们还用默认参数(见补充参数)来评价SAM3 [9],这只支持即时跟踪——因此我们用目标对象的类别名称来初始化.
尽管有这种语义优势,但是在HOTA中,UGO超过了SAM36%,在MOTA中则超过了22%,这表明实例覆盖率和总体跟踪稳健性明显增强.

blocks.en: Table 1: State-of-the-art comparison on the GMOT-40 [ 3 ] benchmark.
blocks.zh: 表1:GMOT-40[3]基准的最新比较。

blocks.en:
UGO achieves the highest mostly tracked rate (MT), surpassing S-DETR [ 23 ] by 25% and the lowest (-39%) mostly lost rate (ML), demonstrating a superior tracking stability.
This highlights the effectiveness of the proposed pixel-level consolidation and evidence-gated memory mechanisms in enforcing consistent, globally coordinated identity assignment.
As illustrated in Figure 4 , the proposed consolidation resolves overlapping masks into mutually exclusive, pixel-consistent instance segmentations. By enforcing competition at the pixel level rather than relying on box-level matching (standard in prior SOTA), consolidation resolves ambiguous shared regions and corrects over-segmentation errors before they accumulate temporally. This prevents identity switches and trajectory fragmentations, especially in dense scenes with visually similar instances.
blocks.zh:
UGO实现了大部分跟踪率最高(MT),超过S-DETR[23]25%,最低(-39%)大多丢失(ML),显示跟踪稳定性较高.
这突出显示了拟议的像素级整合和有证据的记忆机制在强制执行一致、全球协调的身份分配方面的效力。
如图4所示,拟议的合并解决了相互排斥、与像素一致的口罩问题。 通过在像素层面强制竞争,而不是依靠箱级匹配(标准在之前的SOTA),合并解决了模糊的共享区域,并纠正了过度分解的错误后再暂时积累. 这可以防止身份开关和轨迹破碎,特别是在有类似视觉情况的密集场景中。

blocks.en:
Compared to S-DETR, UGO reduces false negatives by 42% at a cost of 31% higher FP rate, while it overall produces a better temporal coverage of target-category instances, as observed in 6% higher F1 score.
Inspection of S-DETR code revealed usage of sequence-specific thresholds to reduce false positives, while UGO relies on a fixed setting, indicating its gains come from architecture. Overall, UGO achieves state-of-the-art performance with strong cross-category generalization.
blocks.zh:
与S-DETR相比,UGO将假负数减少42%,成本为高31%的FP率,而总体来说,它能对目标类别案例产生更好的时间覆盖,如高6%的F1分所观察到的.
对S-DETR代码的检查揭示出使用特定序列阈值来减少假正数,而UGO依赖于固定设置,表明其收益来自架构. 总体而言,UGO通过强跨类别通论实现最先进的性能.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with specialist trackers
blocks.zh: 4.2 与专家追踪器的比较

blocks.en: Next, we compare UGO on benchmarks with trackers specialized for individual object categories. These setups are particularly challenging for generalist UGO, since it has not been fine-tuned per category, unlike its competitors.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们将基准UGO与针对单个对象类别的跟踪器进行比较。 这些设置对于通俗主义的UGO来说特别有挑战性,因为它与竞争对手不同,没有按类别进行微调.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Incorrect masks spreading over several objects are corrected by the proposed detector-tracker consolidation method, enabling accurate memory updates and preventing drifts.
blocks.zh: 图4 分布在多个物体上的不正确口罩通过拟议的探测器-跟踪器合并方法得到纠正,从而能够准确更新内存并预防漂移.

blocks.en:
Evaluation on AnimalTrack. AnimalTrack benchmark [ 43 ] evaluates classical MOT trackers on 10 different animal species. The benchmark provides training sets with category-specific labels to train the MOT trackers for each test category.
Since iconic exemplars are not provided, UGO randomly selects five ground-truth bounding boxes from the first frame to define the target category.
blocks.zh:
动物追踪评估. 动物追踪基准[43]评价了10个不同动物物种的古典MOT跟踪器. 该基准提供带有特定类别标签的培训集,为每个测试类别培训MOT跟踪器。
由于未提供标志性实例,UGO从第一个框架随机选择了5个地真框来定义目标类别.

blocks.en:
Table 2 shows that UGO outperforms all state-of-the-art methods.
UGO surpasses the strongest specialist method QDTrack [ 29 ] by 26% HOTA and 27% IDF1.
Remarkably, UGO tracks 2 × 2\times more instances than competing trackers, while producing 4 × 4\times fewer identity switches and half the number of fragmentations.
We additionally evaluate SAM3 [ 9 ] , following Sec. 4.1 .
Since SAM3 relies on text prompts rather than exemplar conditioning, it benefits from an explicit semantic specification of the target (e.g., “geese”), whereas UGO must infer the category purely from visual evidence in a few exemplars.
Despite its semantic advantage and large-scale detection training, UGO surpasses SAM3 by 14% HOTA and 23% MOTA, demonstrating superior performance.
blocks.zh:
表2显示,UGO的绩效超过了所有最先进的方法.
UGO超越了最强的专家方法QDTRCK[29],增加了26%的HOTA和27%的IDF1.
值得注意的是,UGO轨迹2×2\times比相竞争的跟踪器更多实例,而生成4×4\tims的标识开关更少,破碎数更是一半.
此外,我们评价SAM3 [9],遵循第4.1条。
由于SAM3依赖于文字提示而不是示例条件,它得益于目标的明确语义说明(如"地"),而UGO必须在几个示例中纯粹从视觉证据中推断出这个类别.
尽管其语义优势和大规模检测训练,UGO却以14%的HOTA和23%的MOTA超过了SAM3,表现出了优异的性能.

blocks.zh: 表2:动物追踪最新比较[43].

blocks.en:
The primary limitation of UGO is a higher FP rate, resulting in a 3% lower MOTA than QDTrack [ 29 ] .
Inspection reveals that a third of FPs originate from the goose_3 sequence, where similar bird species are also detected, reflecting ambiguity in exemplar-based category specification.
Nevertheless, UGO achieves superior identity quality and tracking performance, highlighting strong generalization without category-specific training.
blocks.zh:
UGO的主要限制是FP率较高,导致MOTA比QDTRCK [29].
检查发现有三分之一的FP来源于鹅_3序列,在那里也检测出相似的鸟类物种,反映出以实例为基础的分类规格模糊不清.
尽管如此,UGO还是取得了较高的身份质量和跟踪性能,凸显出未经特定类别培训的强通化.

blocks.en:
Evaluation on MOT17. We next evaluate UGO on the human-centric MOT17 benchmark [ 28 ] , again with the same setup as in AnimalTrack.
Table 4 reports a comparison with three standard MOT baselines, and state-of-the-art OC-SORT [ 8 ] .
UGO outperforms all MOT baseline specialists in HOTA, demonstrating strong joint detection-association reasoning, but lags behind the sota, which exploits in-domain category-specific training, in particular the excellent fine-tuned person detectors, which lead to superior detection accuracy (DetA in Table 4 ).
This is evident from a 24% DetA drop of OC-SORT using a public human detector.
Meanwhile, comparable association accuracy to that of OC-SORT ∗ indicates the effectiveness of the consolidation module responsible for association.
blocks.zh:
对MOT17的评价. 接下来我们用以人类为中心的 MOT17 基准来评估UGO [28], 和动物追踪系统一样。
表4报告了与三个标准多指标类集机会基线和最新技术的OC-SORT [8] 的比较。
UGO优于HOTA的所有MOT基线专家,表现出强大的联合检测-关联推理,但落后于Sota,它利用了域内特定类别培训,特别是出色的微调人探测器,这导致了更高的检测精度(表4中的DetA)。
从使用公共人类探测器的OC-SORT下降24%的DetA就可以看出这一点。
同时,与OC-SORT* 相似的关联准确度表明负责关联的合并模块的有效性。

blocks.en: 4.3 Comparison with video object counters
blocks.zh: 4.3 与视频对象计数器的比较

blocks.en:
We finally evaluate UGO in video object counting performance on the recent ScienceCount benchmark [ 2 ] .
The MAE and RMSE [ 2 ] , computed by counting trajectories without final confirmation-based filtering, are reported in Table 4 .
UGO outperforms the sota
CountVid [ 2 ] by 18%/27% in MAE and 25%/27% in RMSE on the Penguins and Crystals subsets, respectively.
Notably, CountVid is a video counting specialist, employing a multistage, forward-backward tracking pipeline with separate detection and tracking backbones. While UGO processes the video in a single pass, its dominance over the counting specialist emphasizes the strong generalization capabilities.

我们最终在视频对象中评价UGO,

UGO 优于此

Consolidation module .
Several variations are considered (Table 5 ).
The first, UGO CONS ¯ \overline{\mathrm{CONS}} , has the consolidation module removed, and each detection is associated by the instance tracker with highest corresponding IoU.
UGO CONS ¯ \overline{\mathrm{CONS}} results in
20% HOTA and 30% MOTA drops compared to UGO and nearly 2 × 2\times as many trajectory fragmentations,
due to missed detections and weak temporal consistency.
Next, the consolidation module is replaced by Hungarian matching [ 18 ] (UGO HM ) for optimal assignment between tracker and detector masks.
UGO HM results in 18% HOTA and 90% MOTA performance drops. The results verify the importance and robustness of the proposed consolidation module, which standard MOT-style matching strategies cannot replace.

blocks.en: Category-level memory . Removing FIFO and keeping only the initial exemplar in the memory (UGO 1ex ), leads to 5% MOTA and 2% HOTA drop (Table 5 ), indicating that adaptive exemplar updates not only enhance instance discovery but also improve long-term identity consistency by stable trajectories mining. Constructing memory from four randomly selected ground-truth boxes from the first frame and keeping it fixed throughout the sequence (UGO 4-rand-GT ) leads to 4% MOTA and 1% HOTA drops, further emphasizing the benefits of our on-the-fly trajectory mining.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced UGO, a unified general multi-object tracker that integrates exemplar-conditioned detection and mask-based instance propagation within a single architecture.
A novel consolidation module resolves conflicting and over-segmented outputs, yielding mutually exclusive masks, while hierarchical memory enables robust global and per-instance modeling.
UGO achieves state-of-the-art performance in GMOT and video counting, while remaining competitive with specialist MOT methods, thus confirming the potential of the new GMOT design paradigm.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了UGO, 一个统一的通用多对象跟踪器, 将模范条件检测和基于面具的实例传播 在一个单一的架构内。
一个新式的整合模块解决了相互矛盾和过于分化的产出,产生了相互排斥的口罩,而分级记忆则能够建立强有力的全球和每层模式。
UGO在GMOT和视频计数中实现了最先进的性能,同时保持了与专业的MOT方法的竞争,从而证实了新的GMOT设计范式的潜力.

blocks.en: A.1 The labeling cost function
blocks.zh: A.1 国家 标签成本函数

blocks.en:
To enforce a desired behavior of the optimization (as discussed in the paper, Section 3.3), we introduce two label-wise potentials Θ 1 ​ ( s , 𝐘 ) \Theta_{1}(s;\mathbf{Y}) and Θ 2 ​ ( s , 𝐘 ) \Theta_{2}(s;\mathbf{Y}) – for brevity we will omit Y in the following, i.e., Θ 1 ​ ( s ) \Theta_{1}(s) and Θ 2 ​ ( s ) \Theta_{2}(s) .
We define these potentials to encode:

blocks.en:
The hierarchical adaptive memory (HAM), described in Section 3.5 , consists of two complementary components: a category-level memory ℳ t D \mathcal{M}^{D}_{t} used for exemplar-conditioned detection, and per-instance memories { ℳ t , k T } \{\mathcal{M}^{T}_{t,k}\} used for instance propagation, see Figure 5 .
The category-level memory maintains a compact set of reliable exemplars, while each instance-level memory is decomposed into distractor-resolving (DRM) and recent appearance (RAM) buffers, enabling robust discrimination and temporal adaptation.
The two levels are tightly coupled through consolidation: reliable tracks update ℳ t D \mathcal{M}^{D}_{t} , while consolidation-driven corrections trigger updates of ℳ t , k T \mathcal{M}^{T}_{t,k} , ensuring consistent global and instance-level representations.

blocks.en:
Table 6 provides extended results on AnimalTrack, including false positives (FP), false negatives (FN), precision, recall, and F1 score (Table 6 ).
The results show that UGO besides achieving the highest HOTA, it achieves the highest recall and F1 score among all compared trackers.
In particular, UGO reduces FN (40157 FN) at least two-fold compared to all specialist methods, including QDTrack (83057 FN), demonstrating significantly better temporal coverage of target instances.
Although UGO produces more false positives than some specialist detectors (e.g., OMC or QDTrack), it achieves the strongest overall F1 performance.
This confirms that UGO favors consistent instance coverage and identity preservation over overly conservative detection suppression.
blocks.zh:
表6提供了动物追踪的扩展结果,包括假阳性(FP),假阴性(FN),精度,召回和F1分(表6).
结果显示,UGO除了实现最高的HOTA,还实现了所有比较的追踪者中最高的回放和F1分.
特别是,与所有专家方法(包括QDTRack(83057 FN))相比,UGO将FN(40157 FN)至少减少两倍,表明目标病例的时间覆盖面明显提高。
虽然UGO产生的假阳性比一些专家探测器(如OMC或QDTRCK)要多,但它实现了最强的整体F1性能.
这证实了UGO倾向于一致的实例覆盖和身份保存,而不是过于保守的检测压制.

blocks.en:
We additionally evaluate SAM3 [ 9 ] on AnimalTrack.
Unlike UGO, SAM3 does not support exemplar-conditioned multi-object tracking in the GMOT sense, where a single first-frame exemplar defines the category for the entire video. While SAM3 allows image exemplars as prompts, these are applied within the same frame (e.g., for the detection of all objects of the same category in that frame) and are not designed, nor do they work, as a persistent cross-frame category specification.
We therefore evaluate SAM3 using a text prompt specifying the ground-truth category for each sequence, which aligns with its standard usage in video tracking.
blocks.zh:
我们额外评估SAM3 [9] 在动物追踪。
与UGO不同的是,SAM3不支持GMOT意义上的以实例为条件的多对象跟踪,即一个单一的一帧实例定义了整个视频的类别. 虽然SAM3允许将图像实例作为提示,但这些实例是在同一框架范围内应用的(例如用于检测该框架中所有同一类对象),并且没有设计,也没有作为持久的跨框架类别规格来工作.
因此,我们利用文字提示来评估SAM3,该提示规定了每一序列的地真相类别,这与视频跟踪的标准使用一致。

blocks.en:
Text prompting offers a semantic advantage over exemplar-based specification, particularly for fine-grained categories.
A textual label such as “duck” or “goose” explicitly defines the target class, whereas a few visual exemplars may not clearly indicate whether only that species or also visually similar birds should be tracked.
For example, bird species can appear highly similar in crowded scenes, making the category boundary ambiguous from a few exemplars.
Moreover, SAM3 is trained on large-scale image and video segmentation data spanning a broad set of visual concepts, which supports strong generalization under semantic (text) prompting. In contrast, the few-shot detector used in UGO is not explicitly trained for the target categories and must rely solely on limited exemplar supervision. Despite this advantage, UGO outperforms SAM3 on the primary tracking metrics.
This exposes an important constraint/limitation of UGO.
Since the target category is specified only through visual exemplars, UGO cannot explicitly control the semantic granularity of the category to be tracked, which is inherited from GECO2 detector [ 30 ] .
blocks.zh:
文字提示比以实例为基础的规格具有语义上的优势,对于精细的类别尤其如此。
一种文字标签,如 " Duck " 或 " Goose " ,明确界定了目标类别,而一些视觉实例可能无法清楚地说明是否应只跟踪该物种或视同鸟类。
例如,鸟类物种在拥挤的场景中可以出现高度相似的外观,使得分类边界从几个例子中变得模糊.
此外,SAM3还接受了大规模图像和视频分解数据的培训,这些分解数据涵盖一系列广泛的视觉概念,支持在语义(文本)提示下进行强通化. 相形之下,UGO中使用的几发探测器并没有为目标类别进行明确的训练,必须只依靠有限的实例监督. 尽管有这一优势,UGO在主跟踪度量衡上仍然优于SAM3.
这暴露出UGO的一个重要约束/限制.
由于目标类别仅通过视觉实例来指定,UGO无法明确控制被跟踪类别的语义颗粒性,这从GECO2探测器[30]中继承来.

In contrast, UGO must infer the category solely from visual evidence contained in a few exemplars, without access to explicit semantic supervision, which is a hard task in fine-grained classification Figure 6 .
Despite this advantage, UGO outperforms SAM3 on the primary tracking metrics.
UGO outperforms SAM3 in HOTA by 14% and a remarkable 23% MOTA.
While SAM3 produces fewer identity switches and fragmentations, it is because of lower detection recall (20% lower relatively) and reduced overall instance coverage.
These results highlight that the proposed exemplar-driven consolidation and memory mechanism provides stronger identity consistency and more complete tracking, even without access to explicit semantic category labels.
blocks.zh:
相比之下,UGO必须仅从几个实例中包含的视觉证据推断出这个类别,而无法获得明确的语义监督,这是精细分类图6中的一项艰巨任务.
尽管有这一优势,UGO在主跟踪度量衡上比SAM3表现优异.
UGO在HOTA中的表现比SAM3高出14%,显著的MOTA为23%.
虽然SAM3的特性开关和分解率较低,但这是因为检测回转率较低(相对较低为20%),整体实例覆盖率也有所下降。
这些结果凸显出,拟议的由实例驱动的整合和内存机制提供了更强大的身份一致性和更完整的跟踪,即使没有获得明确的语义类标签.

blocks.en:
For evaluating SAM3 [ 9 ] , we use the default parameters of the official video predictor. Table 7 summarizes these thresholds. SAM3 uses a loose association threshold to avoid duplicate masklet creation, while a stricter threshold determines whether an existing masklet is sufficiently supported by detector evidence. Newly initialized masklets are further filtered during a hotstart period, in which unmatched masklets or those repeatedly duplicating existing trajectories are removed.
In contrast, UGO omits many of these thresholds by using the proposed consolidation module, since duplicate handling, new instance discovery, even mask correction, and instance memory update logic are handled in a single unified step.
blocks.zh:
为了评价SAM3 [9],我们使用官方视频预测器的默认参数. 表7概述了这些阈值。 SAM3使用松散的关联阈值来避免重复的口罩创建,而更严格的阈值则决定了现有的口罩是否有足够的探测器证据支持. 新初始化的口罩在发热起动期被进一步过滤出,在发热起动期取出未匹配口罩或重复现有轨迹的口罩.
相形之下,UGO通过使用所拟议的合并模块来省略许多这些阈值,因为重复处理,新实例发现,甚至遮住校正,实例内存更新逻辑都是以单一的统一步骤处理的.

blocks.en: Appendix E Application to Single-target Tracking
blocks.zh: 附录E 单一目标跟踪应用

blocks.en:
Although UGO is primarily designed for tracking multiple objects within a specified category, it can be naturally adapted to the single-object tracking (SOT) setting, where only a single instance annotated in the first frame must be tracked throughout the sequence.
To further test UGO’s cross-task generalization capability, we evaluate it on a recent challenging dataset for single-target tracking DiDi [ 36 ] .
blocks.zh:
虽然UGO主要是为了跟踪指定类别内的多个物体而设计的,但它可以自然地适应于单对象跟踪(SOT)的设置,在这种设置中,整个序列中只必须跟踪第一个框中附加注释的单个实例.
为了进一步测试UGO的跨任务通用能力,我们用最近用于单目标跟踪DiDi[36]的具有挑战性的数据集来评价.

blocks.en:
Only a minimal modification of the original algorithm is required: we disable instance termination for the initialized target.
This adjustment ensures that the tracker remains active even during extended periods of occlusion or temporary disappearance - scenarios that occur more frequently in SOT than in gMOT - to enable target re-detection.
blocks.zh:
只需要对原始算法进行最小的修改: 我们对初始化目标禁用实例终止 。
这种调整确保了追踪器即使在长时间被隔离或暂时消失的情况下仍然保持活性——在SOT比在gMOT中更经常发生的情况——以便能够重新探测目标。

blocks.en:
Table 9 compares UGO with the tracking foundation model SAM2.1 [ 33 ] and its recent state-of-the-art SOT extension DAM4SAM [ 36 ] .
UGO surpasses SAM2.1 by 5.5% and achieves performance comparable to DAM4SAM, with only 1.3% lower tracking quality.
Considering that UGO is fundamentally a multi-target tracker, this result highlights its strong generalization capability across different tracking paradigms.

考虑到UGO基本上是一个多目标跟踪器,这一结果凸显出它在不同跟踪范式上的强通化能力.
